svg.title: Full diagram: logical memory, page table, physical memory with translations for addresses 3 and 9
svg.desc: Logical memory 16 bytes (pages 0-3), page table mapping VPN 0→2, 1→0, 2→1, and physical memory 32 bytes (frames 0-7), with highlighted translations for logical addresses 3 and 9.
svg.text: n=2 (offset bits) → page size = 4 B | m=4 (addr bits) → 16 B logical space | 32 B physical = 8 frames
★ = queried bytes color = which page/frame the data belongs to
